text: dsh-plugin-browser 是面向 DSH 的浏览器自动化插件，通过 ctx.tools 注册浏览器操作工具，使用 Playwright 连接专用 Chrome 或启动独立浏览器会话。它可以导航网页、识别可交互元素并点击、输入、选择和悬停，管理标签页与 JavaScript 弹窗，读取页面存储和控制台，执行页面表达式、截图，并在登录或验证码环节等待人工处理。适合希望让 DSH 会话操作网页、复用专用 Chrome 登录状态或使用隔离浏览器的用户。无需 API Key；需要本机 Chrome，isolated 模式使用 Playwright Chromium。

dsh-plugin-browser gives DSH Playwright tools to use a dedicated Chrome or isolated browser. It navigates pages, inspects and operates controls, manages tabs and dialogs, reads storage and logs, evaluates page expressions, takes screenshots, and waits for human input. No API key is needed.
想让 DSH 帮我打开网页并操作网页上的按钮和表单。
能不能让会话使用一个已经登录的 Chrome 来浏览网站？
我需要自动浏览网页、查看可点击元素，再按页面内容填写输入框。
让 DSH 可以管理浏览器标签页、切换页面和处理弹窗。
I want my DSH session to navigate websites and interact with page controls.
Can DSH use a dedicated Chrome profile and keep its login session?
I need an isolated browser session for automated web tasks.
Help me inspect a page, fill a form, and save a screenshot from DSH.
浏览器导航与会话：通过 browser_session 选择 real 专用 Chrome 或 isolated 独立会话，browser_navigate 打开指定 URL；首次使用 real 模式会尝试启动 Chrome。
页面元素操作：browser_snapshot 列出可交互元素并给出临时 ref，随后可用 browser_click、browser_type、browser_select_option 和 browser_hover 与页面交互。
标签页与弹窗管理：browser_tabs 可列出、新建、切换或关闭标签页；browser_handle_dialog 可配置后续 JavaScript 弹窗的确认或取消方式。
页面检查与截图：browser_eval 执行页面表达式，browser_storage 读取 cookies 或 Web Storage，browser_console 获取日志，browser_screenshot 保存页面图片。
人工步骤等待：遇到登录或验证码等需要人操作的环节，可调用 browser_wait_human 在 DSH 界面提出问题并等待确认，最长等待五分钟。
该实现将 real 模式的专用 Chrome 用户数据保存在 CDP profile 目录，并把截图写入本机 bw-shots 目录；相关路径可通过环境变量配置。
同一 DSH 进程中的会话共享模块级浏览器实例；工具调用通过串行链执行，切换会话会先释放当前实例。
安装时应在机器/用户配置插入插件行或使用 bundle 方式二选一；bundle 文件提示重复插入相同 id 会导致 profile 启动失败。

给 [DSH（DeepSeek Harness）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)装上 15 个浏览器工具:会话里的模型可以直接操作一个**已登录的真实 Chrome**——你在浏览器里登过什么(GitHub、内网、订阅站点),模型就能访问什么,不用重新输密码。

```
你: 帮我看看 github 今天有什么通知
模型: browser_navigate → browser_snapshot → 读到通知列表 → 汇报给你
```

dsh-plugin-browser README · 工具(15 个)：| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `browser_session` | 启动/切换会话(`real` 已登录 Chrome \| `isolated` 独立无痕) |
| `browser_navigate` | 打开 URL |
| `browser_snapshot` | 列出页面可交互元素,带 `ref` 编号(默认只列视口内,省 token) |
| `browser_click` / `browser_type` / `browser_select_option` / `browser_hover` | 点击/输入/选下拉/悬停,用 `ref` 精确定位 |
| `browser_tabs` | 标签页管理(列出/切换/关闭/新建) |
| `browser_handle_dialog` | 预设 JS 弹窗(alert/confirm)的处理策略 |
| `browser_eval` | 在页面执行 JS(等同 F12 控制台) |
| `browser_storage` / `browser_console` | 读 cookies/localStorage / 读控制台日志 |
| `browser_wait_human` | 遇到验证码/登录时**在 DSH 界面弹卡片等你操作完确认**(5 分钟超时) |
| `browser_screenshot` | 截图存文件 |
| `browser_close` | 关闭会话(real 模式只断连接,不关你的 Chrome) |
dsh-plugin-browser README · 工具(15 个)：Chrome 没开?插件会自动拉起,不需要你手动启动。

text:
dsh-plugin-browser README · 配置(全部可选)：| 环境变量 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `AGENT_BROWSER_DIR` | `~/.pi/agent` | 根目录,下面几项默认从这里派生 |
| `AGENT_BROWSER_CHROME_STARTER` | `<根目录>/start-agent-chrome.sh` | 自定义 Chrome 启动脚本(存在则优先用;适合要挂代理/特殊参数的场景) |
| `AGENT_BROWSER_CDP_PROFILE` | `<根目录>/chrome-cdp-profile` | 已登录 Chrome 的用户数据目录——**你的登录态存这里** |
| `AGENT_BROWSER_ISOLATED_PROFILE` | `<根目录>/bw-mcp-profile` | isolated 模式的独立目录 |
| `AGENT_BROWSER_CDP_PORT` | `9222` | CDP 端口 |
| `AGENT_BROWSER_ISOLATED_CHANNEL` | 未设 | 设为 `chrome` 让 isolated 模式用系统 Chrome 而非 Playwright 自带 chromium。**macOS 慎用**:无头系统 Chrome 会被 macOS 认定为"正在运行的 Chrome",导致你点 Dock 图标打不开日常 Chrome |
| `AGENT_BROWSER_NO_SANDBOX` | 未设 | 设为 `1` 强制 Chrome 加 `--no-sandbox`(一般只在特殊环境需要) |

dsh-plugin-browser README · 配置(全部可选)：**默认目录说明**:默认值是为了和 [agentic-browser-mcp](https://github.com/q35888/agentic-browser-mcp)(本插件的原型)的用户无缝共存——两者可以共享同一个已登录 Chrome。如果你没用过它、也不在乎共存,设置 `AGENT_BROWSER_DIR` 换成自己的目录即可,插件会自动创建。

**想带登录态**:首次用 `real` 模式时插件会拉起一个专用 Chrome 窗口(和你的日常浏览器完全独立),**在里面手动登录一次**你要的站点,登录态持久保存在 `AGENT_BROWSER_CDP_PROFILE` 目录,以后每次直接可用。

dsh-plugin-browser README · 使用要点：- **ref 是临时的**:每次 `snapshot` 重新编号,页面变化后先重新 `snapshot` 再操作
- **验证码/二次验证**:模型会调 `browser_wait_human`,DSH 界面弹出卡片,你去浏览器操作完点确认即可
- **多标签页**:新开的标签页自动跟随;需要固定某个标签页用 `browser_tabs` 的 `switch`
- **隐私提示**:`browser_eval`/`browser_storage` 能读取浏览器里的 cookies 和登录凭据——请只在你信任的会话中使用本插件

dsh-plugin-browser README · 故障排查：- **模型说 Chrome 连接失败** —— 插件已内置自愈(窗口全被关掉但 Chrome 进程还活着的"僵尸"状态会自动恢复一个标签页);持续失败就彻底退出 Chrome 再让模型重试
- **自己的 Chrome"点了打不开"**(macOS) —— 旧版本的无头 isolated 会话用系统 Chrome 启动,会被 macOS 认定为"Chrome 正在运行"从而挡住你的日常 Chrome;已修复(isolated 默认用 Playwright 自带 chromium,与系统 Chrome 完全隔离)。若你设置了 `AGENT_BROWSER_ISOLATED_CHANNEL=chrome` 又用无头模式,此现象会复现
- **自动拉起失败(找不到 Chrome)** —— 插件按常见安装位置 + PATH 查找;都找不到时写一个启动脚本并设 `AGENT_BROWSER_CHROME_STARTER` 指向它
- **截图在哪** —— `<根目录>/bw-shots/`

dsh-plugin-browser README · 已知限制：- 同一个 DSH 进程里的多个会话/子代理**共享同一个浏览器标签页**,并发使用时会互相干扰(单会话内已串行保护)
- `isolated` 模式下如果 DSH 意外退出,独立浏览器进程可能残留,手动关闭即可;`real` 模式不受影响
- 依赖 DSH 的 rc 期工具 API,DSH 大版本升级后若失效,删掉机器级配置里的两行即可完全回滚

dsh-plugin-browser README · dsh-plugin-browser：**English** | [中文](./README.md)

15 browser tools for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH): the model in your session can drive a **logged-in real Chrome**. Whatever you are logged into there (GitHub, intranet portals, subscription sites), the model can access it — no re-entering passwords.

```
You:  check my GitHub notifications today
Model: browser_navigate → browser_snapshot → reads the list → reports back
```

dsh-plugin-browser README · Tools (15)：| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `browser_session` | Start/switch session (`real` logged-in Chrome \| `isolated` separate & clean) |
| `browser_navigate` | Open a URL |
| `browser_snapshot` | List interactive elements with `ref` ids (viewport-only by default, token-lean) |
| `browser_click` / `browser_type` / `browser_select_option` / `browser_hover` | click / type / select dropdown / hover, targeted by `ref` |
| `browser_tabs` | Tab management (list / switch / close / new) |
| `browser_handle_dialog` | Pre-set handling for JS dialogs (alert/confirm) |
| `browser_eval` | Run JS in the page (like the F12 console) |
| `browser_storage` / `browser_console` | Read cookies/localStorage / read console logs |
| `browser_wait_human` | On captchas/logins, **shows a card in DSH and waits for you to finish** (5 min timeout) |
| `browser_screenshot` | Save a screenshot to a file |
| `browser_close` | Close the session (`real` only drops the connection; your Chrome stays open) |

dsh-plugin-browser README · Configuration (all optional)：| Env var | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `AGENT_BROWSER_DIR` | `~/.pi/agent` | Root dir; the paths below derive from it |
| `AGENT_BROWSER_CHROME_STARTER` | `<root>/start-agent-chrome.sh` | Custom Chrome launcher script (used first if present; handy for proxies/special flags) |
| `AGENT_BROWSER_CDP_PROFILE` | `<root>/chrome-cdp-profile` | User-data dir of the logged-in Chrome — **your login state lives here** |
| `AGENT_BROWSER_ISOLATED_PROFILE` | `<root>/bw-mcp-profile` | Separate dir for `isolated` mode |
| `AGENT_BROWSER_CDP_PORT` | `9222` | CDP port |
| `AGENT_BROWSER_ISOLATED_CHANNEL` | unset | `chrome` makes isolated mode use the system Chrome instead of Playwright's bundled chromium. **Caution on macOS**: a headless system Chrome gets registered as "Chrome is running" and blocks your daily Chrome from launching via the Dock |
| `AGENT_BROWSER_NO_SANDBOX` | unset | `1` forces `--no-sandbox` (rarely needed) |

dsh-plugin-browser README · Configuration (all optional)：**About the default dir**: defaults exist so users of [agentic-browser-mcp](https://github.com/q35888/agentic-browser-mcp) (this plugin's predecessor) share the same logged-in Chrome seamlessly. If you don't care about that, set `AGENT_BROWSER_DIR` to your own location — the plugin creates it automatically.

dsh-plugin-browser README · Configuration (all optional)：**Bringing login state along**: on first `real`-mode use the plugin opens a dedicated Chrome window (fully separate from your daily browser). **Log in once** to the sites you need — the state persists in `AGENT_BROWSER_CDP_PROFILE` and is available every time after.

dsh-plugin-browser README · Usage notes：- **refs are temporary**: each `snapshot` renumbers them; re-snapshot after the page changes
- **Captchas / 2FA**: the model calls `browser_wait_human`, a card appears in DSH, you finish in the browser and confirm
- **Tabs**: newly opened tabs are followed automatically; pin one with `browser_tabs` `switch`
- **Privacy note**: `browser_eval`/`browser_storage` can read cookies and login credentials from the browser — use this plugin only in sessions you trust

dsh-plugin-browser README · Troubleshooting：- **Model reports Chrome connection failure** — self-healing is built in (the "zombie" state where all windows are closed but the process lives is recovered automatically); if it keeps failing, fully quit Chrome and let the model retry
- **Your own Chrome won't open from the Dock** (macOS) — older versions launched headless isolated sessions with the system Chrome, which macOS treats as "Chrome already running", blocking your daily Chrome; fixed (isolated now uses Playwright's bundled chromium, fully separate). Setting `AGENT_BROWSER_ISOLATED_CHANNEL=chrome` with headless mode brings this back
- **Auto-launch fails (Chrome not found)** — the plugin checks common install locations plus PATH; if all else fails, write a launcher script and point `AGENT_BROWSER_CHROME_STARTER` at it
- **Where are screenshots** — `<root>/bw-shots/`

dsh-plugin-browser README · Known limitations：- Multiple sessions/subagents in one DSH process **share the same browser tab** and can interfere with each other when used concurrently (serial protection exists within a single session)
- If DSH exits unexpectedly during `isolated` mode, the separate browser process may linger — close it manually; `real` mode is unaffected
- Depends on DSH's rc-phase tooling API; if it breaks after a major DSH upgrade, removing the two machine-level config rows fully rolls back
